task.ques: Find a set of solar-powered garden lights on Amazon with a minimum pack of 10 lights. They should be LED and priced under $50.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: DenicMic 10 Pack Solar Pathway Lights Outdoor Waterproof Warm White LED — $23.39 for 10 lights, before shipping and tax. The selected Warm White 10Pack meets all requirements: 10 lights, LED, solar-powered, and suitable for garden use. Amazon’s description confirms the solar panels convert sunlight into electrical energy.
Source: https://www.amazon.com/DenicMic-Pathway-Waterproof-Stainless-Driveway/dp/B0C1Z6P1QG/
Verified October 27, 2026. Evidence: final.png.
